name: 设置 / 请求 Trace 导出 / OTLP 测试 span、加密请求头、采样比例、保存与关闭

runtime_evidence.reason: The OpenTelemetry collector is an audited local OTLP/HTTP fixture. The server, encrypted header storage, browser and SQLite are real; no agent, GPU, container or engine is claimed.

crud.create: UI Save stores the export setting through PUT /api/v1/telemetry/export
crud.read: The card, reload and independent GET preserve enabled, endpoint, sample ratio, trace link and header names
crud.update: Switch off/on, header value kept when left blank, sample ratio percent-to-ratio conversion, endpoint changed for a failing test
crud.delete: Cleanup clears the export setting and the independent GET returns the defaults

checklist_items.1.1: The export control is one switch named by the export label. It is not marked required and its default is off. The collector address is one textbox named by that label. It is not marked required and its value is empty. Headers start with no row and no secret field, and the add-header button is the only header control. The sample ratio is one spinbutton named by that label. It is not marked required, its value is 100, its unit is %, its minimum is 0, its maximum is 100, and its step is 1. The trace link is one textbox named by that label. It is not marked required and its value is empty. The switch being off leaves the address, the ratio, and the trace link visible. Reading them sends no request. The save request fields are enabled, endpoint, headers, sample_ratio, and trace_link. The independent GET persists enabled false, an empty endpoint, no headers, sample_ratio 1, and an empty trace link.
checklist_items.1.7: Saving the untouched export form fills no fields. The save control is one primary button. Confirming it sends one PUT to /api/v1/telemetry/export whose body is enabled false, an empty collector address, no headers, sample ratio 1, and an empty trace link, with a 200 response that matches the independent GET. The success sentence is visible. After reload the card shows the switch off, the address empty, the ratio at 100, and the trace link empty.
checklist_items.1.12: The collector address changes from http://collector-a.example to http://collector-b.example. The export switch stays off, the sample ratio stays 100, and the trace link stays empty. That save returns 200 and the independent GET keeps the new address with export off, sample ratio 1, no headers, and an empty trace link. The export switch then goes on, off, and on, and the address stays http://collector-b.example after each change. The sample ratio stays 100 and the trace link stays empty. The switch is turned off again and the save returns 200 with export off and the same address. The trace link is set to https://traces.example/cycle/{trace_id} and then cleared. Each save returns 200, and the independent GET keeps the address, export off, and sample ratio 1. A header is saved as Alpha, changed to Beta, and then removed. Each save returns 200. The independent GET header names are Alpha, then Beta, then none, while the address, export off, sample ratio 1, and the empty trace link stay. Clearing the address then returns the disabled defaults.
checklist_items.1.2: covered: While the telemetry GET is held Save stays disabled and the card has no secret field; after the load the switch is off, the endpoint is empty and the ratio is 100, and a later reload shows the saved values without echoing the header
checklist_items.1.9: covered: While the telemetry PUT is held a second click and Enter send no further save, and the later 200 is the only stored export setting
checklist_items.1.10: A failing collector test span keeps the export card open. This card is not a dialog. The collector address stays on the failing address, the header name stays X-E2E-Token, the sample ratio stays 50, the trace link stays set, and the export switch stays off. The error alert and the collector error text stay visible. The independent GET stays enabled false with an empty endpoint, and the test span sends no export save. The card body is one vertical space. Correcting the address to the working collector and sending the test span again returns ok true and the working traces url. The success text is visible. The independent GET stays enabled false with an empty endpoint, and the corrected call sends no export save.
checklist_items.1.14: Reload and independent GET preserve the saved setting and never return the header value
checklist_items.1.15: Tab from the export switch reaches the collector address, the add-header button, the sample ratio, and the trace link. Save can be focused. Enter in the empty collector address sends no telemetry PUT and the address stays empty. A failing collector shows the error alert and the error text. At 1440×900 the address, the sample ratio, the trace link, Save, and the test button are each inside the viewport and the address does not overlap Save, and the trace link and the sample ratio do not overlap the test button.
checklist_items.1.13: While the telemetry card is open on the disabled defaults, another session's PUT of enabled false, endpoint http://other-session.example, no headers, sample ratio 1, and an empty trace link returns 200. The independent GET is that setting. The card still shows the empty address, export off, and sample ratio 100. There is no conflict status. Saving that draft returns 200 with the disabled defaults, and the independent GET returns those defaults.
checklist_items.1.8: Export stays off. The collector address http://collector-optional.example, the header X-Optional, the sample ratio 50 stored as 0.5, and the trace link https://traces.example/optional/{trace_id} are saved together. That save returns 200 and the independent GET matches each field, with the header returned by name only. A PUT of {} that omits every field returns 200. The independent GET is then enabled false, an empty endpoint, no headers, sample ratio 1, and an empty trace link.
checklist_items.3.1: The percent control stores the exact ratio (50% → 0.5) and reads it back
checklist_items.3.2: 0 is the minimum and stays 0. -1 blurs to 0. 100 is the maximum. 101 blurs to 100. 50.4 stays 50.4. Empty becomes 100. A non-numeric entry blurs back to 100. None of those submits a request, and the independent GET stays at sample ratio 1. A direct PUT of sample_ratio 1.5 returns TELEMETRY_SAMPLE_RATIO_INVALID and the stored ratio stays 1
checklist_items.3.3: From 100, ArrowDown shows 99 and ArrowUp returns to 100. The Decrease Value button shows 99 and Increase Value returns to 100. At 0 a further decrease stays 0. At 100 a further increase stays 100. This control has no slider and one spinbutton. None of those steps submits a request, and the independent GET stays at sample ratio 1
checklist_items.6.2: The Export switch is changed off→on→off with exact boolean requests and refresh readback
checklist_items.7.2: A stored header left blank is sent as null, keeps the encrypted value, and the test span reuses it
checklist_items.7.6: The independent GET and artifacts do not expose the header value
checklist_items.22.2: The Settings Integrations tab is selected through the real Tabs control
checklist_items.1.3: covered: no telemetry field is required - every control is asserted to lack aria-required=true, so the empty and whitespace-only cases in this checklist do not apply to a card that accepts an empty endpoint, an empty header list and empty trace link, and those empty values are then saved and read back as the backend defaults.
checklist_items.1.4: covered: each field's own boundary is exercised where the product has one, and none is invented. The percent control is clamped at 0 and 100 by typing 0, -1, 100, 101, 50.4, empty and abc and asserting the shown value each time; the server independently rejects 1.5 with TELEMETRY_SAMPLE_RATIO_INVALID and the stored value stays 1. The address field has no product maximum and is not given one.
checklist_items.1.5: covered: the only enumerated controls are the export switch (off->on->off with exact boolean bodies and readback) and the header rows, and each option is saved and read back rather than only selected.
checklist_items.1.6: covered: the trace link is filled and cleared while the switch is off and the endpoint holds ADDRESS_B, and the collector address is changed A->B with the switch off; after each transition the exact PUT body and an independent GET are compared, so hidden or stale values cannot be submitted unnoticed.
checklist_items.1.11: covered: the collector address and percent are edited without saving, then reloaded, and the card returns to the stored values with no PUT sent; the test-span failure path likewise keeps the draft in place instead of silently discarding it.
checklist_items.3.4: covered: sample_ratio is sent as the JSON number 0.5 for 50% and 1 for 100%, a decimal 50.4 is kept as 50.4, an empty field is stored as 1 rather than null or the string '', and a body that omits the field entirely reads back as 1 - so omitted, null, empty and 0 are distinguished.
checklist_items.3.5: covered: after saving 50% the percent input reads '50', an independent GET reads 0.5, and after a reload the input still reads '50' from the persisted value rather than from the draft. The test span actually sent to the collector carries the saved header and gzip body, so the stored value is what executes.
checklist_items.3.6: covered: the input advertises aria-valuemin 0, aria-valuemax 100 and step 1 and clamps to those bounds; the server rejects 1.5 with TELEMETRY_SAMPLE_RATIO_INVALID and the stored setting is unchanged after the rejection.
checklist_items.6.1: covered: the export switch is asserted to be exactly one switch with the export accessible name, starting unchecked, and it is never disabled on this page.
checklist_items.6.5: covered: the test span against a failing collector shows the error alert while the card stays open, keeps every drafted value, and sends no PUT - and the independent GET confirms nothing was stored - so success is never displayed for a change the backend did not make.
checklist_items.6.6: covered: the switch is verified through real execution, not through its own state - the saved export is sent to a real collector fixture that receives exactly one gzip request carrying the configured header and the expected span, and no request is received while the switch is off.
checklist_items.22.5: covered: the case runs in both en and zh against the same product, reading every label, save and test control, notice, empty default and error string from the active locale bundle, and the collector span names and attributes are compared against fixed product values rather than translated text.
